column2: Wooden stakes can be made from slender tree trunks via [M]ake-menu.

column3: 可以使用木工技能将粗树干劈成木板。

column3: 桌子、长凳，甚至粗大的树干，都可以用作手工作业台。

column2: Almost any stave or staff and even a club can be used as a primitive threshing tool if no proper flail is available.

column2: Axe is preferred, but a sturdy knife for chopping and carving wood can be used as a substitute.

column2: Flowers and leaves of various plants, which can be harvested by using the AGRICULTURE skill.

column3: 大型动物的皮革、毛皮或处理过的皮，通常使用驯鹿皮革。
